content: How wonderful it is to be in love! It's love at first sight! Oh. he's my Romeo!
Um, I was just thinking aloud.
You look so happy. I see a twinkle in your eyes.
Oh, you have a crush on someone, don't you? Maybe those are wedding bells in your eyes!
You certainly do like teasing me, Mary. Well I'm in love with someone. The question is, how do I get his attention?
Well, that's easy. Walk up to him and kiss him.
I guess I asked the wrong person.
